effect: DEBUG MENU (13 game settings), then a game with them (hold L, R, Up on the right pad and Left on the left pad while pressing A)
note: The last two entries of the button-code list ($27EB6). The check ($0702_00F0) wants pad bits L, R, right-pad Up and left-pad Left; with them held in BizHawk the [ DEBUG MENU ] opens with 13 settings, and A starts a game with them. GameFAQs doesn't have it.

effect: DEBUG MENU, then a game where the CPU plays both sides (hold L, R, Up on the right pad and Left on the left pad while pressing A)
note: The last two entries of the button-code list ($27EB6). The check ($0702_00F0) wants pad bits L, R, right-pad Up and left-pad Left; with them held in BizHawk the [ DEBUG MENU ] opens with 13 settings, and A starts a game with them; unlike 0825 (this is sub-mode 3, $0700_6D64) your side is CPU-controlled too, so both fields play themselves and the round replays. GameFAQs doesn't have it.

effect: Your pad moves both sides: the opponent's field follows your Left and Right (hold L and R while entering)
note: Sets $0500_24E8; the opponent's control word becomes 1 instead of $101 ($0700_6DDE), so player 1's pad drives both fields and the CPU never moves. Typed in BizHawk with L and R held: both falling pieces move together.

effect: A RESULT screen after every round: level, chains, giant bombs, stage times (hold L and R while entering)
note: Sets $0500_24E0; after each round the main loop calls the RESULT screen ($0700_7E46) that normally comes only after the ending. Typed in BizHawk with L and R held.

effect: Other block pieces in every game
note: Sets $0500_24F4; a normal game then uses piece set (TUBU) 5 instead of its own ($0700_7C1A). Typed in BizHawk.

effect: Skull blocks in every game (hold L and R while entering)
note: Sets $0500_24E4, which turns DOKURO on at every stage start ($0700_7BBA): the 8-block attack row uses the skull block (type 11, $0700_97F2) instead of type 6. Read from the code; the attack row needs chains, which a short test game didn't make.

effect: Slowest animation in every game (hold L and R while entering)
note: Clears $0500_2500, so every game runs with ANIMATION 0 (an animation step every 4th frame, $0700_EC68). Read from the code.

effect: Developer menu at power-on: VERSION 1995/07/21 with GAME START, DEBUG GAME PLAY, DEBUG AUTO PLAY, SOUND TEST, ENDING
note: The menu ($0700_0A48) is in the ROM but nothing calls it. The patch calls it from boot mode 0 (file $06B2) and points its three debug items at the sub-mode word the finished game reads ($0500_24F8; they still wrote the old byte $0500_26D9). Patched file in BizHawk: GAME START boots normally, DEBUG GAME PLAY and DEBUG AUTO PLAY give the DEBUG MENU then a game (as 0825 and 0513), SOUND TEST and ENDING open those.

effect: SCROLL, ANIMATION, DOKURO, TUBU, ENEMY, WORLD, SPEED, COLOR, ERASE, ITEM, EVENT, WIN, CPU: the 13 values a stage normally sets for you
note: Left-pad Right and Left change a value. SCROLL background scroll on/off; ANIMATION rate (0 slowest); DOKURO skull attack blocks; TUBU piece set 0-5; ENEMY the opponent 0-10; WORLD the background 0-3; SPEED drop speed 0-5; COLOR block kinds 1-5; ERASE blocks in a row to clear 1-6; ITEM forces one item type; EVENT forces one event and lowers the chain thresholds; WIN rounds to win; CPU the CPU level of both sides. Seen in BizHawk: SCROLL, TUBU, ENEMY, WORLD, SPEED, COLOR and ERASE; the rest read from the code (menu $0700_64B0, stage tables from $0702_6588).
